profile_text.body:
XPENG INC. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou, listed under the ticker XPEV, and its Spanish site presents the XPENG España range of fully electric vehicles under the slogan "Xpande tu mundo." The company says it has been turning what the world calls the future into reality since 2014, and describes its G6, G9 and P7+ models as combining artificial intelligence, advanced driver assistance systems and the SEPA 2.0 800-volt electric platform, which it says allows charging from 10% to 80% in 12 minutes across the range. It also states that all three models carry the DGT CERO label and a warranty of up to 7 years or 160,000 km.

The site's AI and technology claims are presented as product features rather than as separate AI products, and no products, lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for the company. The Spanish page is a lead-capture and sales page, inviting visitors to leave their details to test a model or learn more.

The site names CAETANO AUTOMOTIVE ESPAÑA DISTRIBUCIÓN, S.L.U. as the data controller for enquiries, and states that financing is offered subject to approval by Open Bank, S.A. As an example of pricing, it lists the G6 RWD Standard Range at a cash price of 41.122,71€ and a financed price of 37.522,71 €, with the offer valid until 30/09/2026.
